title: Understanding Campus Safety and Hostel Regulations at Banasthali Vidyapith
body:
## Campus Safety at Banasthali Vidyapith

When considering a safe environment for your child, Banasthali Vidyapith prioritizes the well-being of its students. The campus is designed to foster a secure atmosphere, ensuring that students can focus on their education without concerns about safety.

## Hostel Rules and Regulations

Hostel residence is compulsory for most students, with specific exemptions for wards of workers or those from neighboring villages. This policy helps create a close-knit community where students can support each other. 

## Security and Supervision

The campus is equipped with adequate security measures to ensure student safety. Regular supervision and monitoring are in place to maintain a secure living environment in the hostels. Additionally, students must undergo a medical examination before final admission, ensuring their health and well-being are prioritized.

### Evidence
- [Hostel residence is compulsory for admitted students](http://www.banasthali.org/banasthali/wcms/e/home/admissions/index.html)
- [Final admission requires a medical examination](http://www.banasthali.org/banasthali/wcms/e/home/admissions/campus_rules/index.html)
- [Students must collect belongings by the end of October](http://www.banasthali.org/banasthali/wcms/e/home/admissions/campus_rules/index.html)
- [Hostel admission exemptions for specific categories](http://www.banasthali.ac.in/banasthali/wcms/hi/home/admissions/index.html)
- [Banasthali Vidyapith's educational program focuses on all-round development](http://www.banasthali.org/)

faq.a: Yes, hostel residence is compulsory for most students, with specific exemptions.

faq.a: The campus has adequate security measures and regular supervision to ensure student safety.

faq.q: What is the process for final admission?
faq.a: Final admission requires a medical examination and the approval of the Chief Warden.
